name: player_zar_register_sections
description: Player::ZAR_RegisterSections resets the player runtime input flag and registers the VehicleList and Player ZAR section callbacks.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded; tier S verification is deferred to the coherent player save/load or VehicleList source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x41f5b0 validates the g_Player_RuntimeInputFlags reset, VehicleList registration with write/read callbacks and sort order 100, and Player registration with write/read callbacks and sort order 200.
The native smoke verifies the reset flag and the two registered zZbdSectionHandler records, including section names, callback pointers, sort orders, user data, and insertion order.
